question: Should OpenClaw stop treating typed Codex `savedPath` values as deliverable media when the typed item omits transferable `result` bytes?
rationale: The upstream Codex contract supports using `result`, but removing path-only fallback can intentionally stop a local-only behavior if Codex ever emits savedPath without result; repository policy treats message-delivery fallback changes as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Accept result-only transfer
options.body: Use typed `result` bytes as the deliverable app-server image payload and warn on path-only typed items after the stale integration test and proof are fixed.

options.title: Keep a local-only fallback
options.body: Preserve `savedPath` only when the app-server is proven local to the gateway and add tests for that boundary.

recommendation.title: Accept result-only transfer
recommendation.body: Use typed `result` bytes as the deliverable app-server image payload and warn on path-only typed items after the stale integration test and proof are fixed.
